title: KS3 History: KS3: Medieval England & The Struggle for Power (1066–1485)
subtitle: A condensed roadmap and revision sheet for this unit.

topics.title: 1. 1066 - Why did three men claim one throne, and how did William win?
points: **Objective:** To understand 1066 - Why did three men claim one throne, and how did William win?
**Key Topics:** Witan, Claimant, Succession Crisis, Feigned Retreat, Shield Wall

topics.title: 2. Castles, Terror, and the Domesday Book - How did William control England?
points: **Objective:** To understand Castles, Terror, and the Domesday Book - How did William control England?
**Key Topics:** Motte, Bailey, Palisade, Harrying, Domesday Book, Shire, Tenant-in-chief

topics.title: 3. Crown vs Church: Why did Henry II clash with Thomas Becket?
points: **Objective:** To understand Crown vs Church: Why did Henry II clash with Thomas Becket?
**Key Topics:** Common Law, Canon Law, Benefit of Clergy, Constitutions of Clarendon, Excommunication, Martyr

topics.title: 4. Magna Carta (1215): A triumph of liberty or a selfish baronial power grab?
points: **Objective:** To understand Magna Carta (1215): A triumph of liberty or a selfish baronial power grab?
**Key Topics:** Angevin Empire, Scutage, Papal Interdict, Magna Carta, Clause 39, Habeas Corpus

topics.title: 5. Doom Paintings and Tithes: What was life like in a medieval village?
points: **Objective:** To understand Doom Paintings and Tithes: What was life like in a medieval village?
**Key Topics:** Villein, Tithe, Doom Painting, Purgatory, Harvest

topics.title: 6. 1348: How did the Black Death shatter medieval social order?
points: **Objective:** To understand 1348: How did the Black Death shatter medieval social order?
**Key Topics:** Bubonic Plague, Miasma, Flagellants, Statute of Labourers, Yeoman, Danse Macabre

topics.title: 7. 1381: Why did the Peasants revolt, and did they achieve anything?
points: **Objective:** To understand 1381: Why did the Peasants revolt, and did they achieve anything?
**Key Topics:** Poll Tax, John Ball, Wat Tyler, Simon Sudbury, Smithfield, Manorial Rolls

topics.title: 8. The Wars of the Roses (1455–1485) - How did the medieval era end in blood?
points: **Objective:** To understand The Wars of the Roses (1455–1485) - How did the medieval era end in blood?
**Key Topics:** Dynasty, House of Lancaster, House of York, Usurp, Tudor

topics.title: 9. Assessment: How powerful was a medieval monarch?
points: **Objective:** To understand Assessment: How powerful was a medieval monarch?
**Key Topics:** Feudalism, Harrying, Excommunication, Magna Carta, Pestilence, Revolt
